# LongLens

> LongLens (getlonglens.com) writes a newsletter for a business, under the business's own name. It finds what changed in the business's field, writes an issue that says what it means for the business's clients. The owner can change the words of any issue on the page before sending it, and every issue comes to the owner first. The Email, Podcast, Reel, Infographic, Carousel and Explainer video are all part of the issue. Free for a week, then from $19 a month.

LongLens is an AI newsletter service for businesses. LongLens finds what changed in your field and tells your clients what it means, under your name only. The Email, Podcast, Reel, Infographic, Carousel and Explainer video are all part of the issue. Every issue comes to you first, and you make it yours on the page before you send it.

LongLens is for any business whose clients ask "what does this mean for me?": accountants, law firms, vet practices, consultants, coaches, recruiters, schools, clubs and associations. It is not a visual effects product. The VFX Supervisor Daily, its founder's own newsletter about his own field, is one example of what it makes.

How it differs from a feed in an email: LongLens judges each story against what the owner said their readers care about. Each story is retold in plain words with a line on why it matters to the reader, the same story from two outlets appears only once, a story readers already had comes back only when something changed, marked as an update, and every story links to its original.

How owners change it: hit Reply on any issue and write what you want in plain words, such as "shorter" or "more on the new rules". LongLens answers in the same email thread with what it understood, and the next issue follows it. Reply UNDO to take a change back. Owners can also click any line of an issue and type.

Prices, in US dollars, paid by invoice. Free for a week, then from $19 a month.
- Free week: $0. A week of real issues, no card. One newsletter, as many sources as you like, up to 25 readers.
- Solo: $19 a month. A newsletter every day or every week. Every format: Email, Podcast, Reel, Infographic, Carousel, Explainer video. Your name, logo and colours, never ours. Sent to your existing clients for you, with a one-click opt-out.
- Business: $95 a month. Everything in Solo. A custom design of your emails, pages and videos, built with you. All your issues on one web page, like a blog. Each issue posted to your Slack or Discord channel, and an RSS feed.

How to start: fill in the form at https://getlonglens.com/contact/ with the websites or feeds to follow (optional), the topics to follow, and an email address. The first issue arrives by email in about 5 minutes. After that, issues arrive on weekdays at 07:00 local time, or on the days and time the owner picks. Every issue ends with a Stop button.

LongLens does not write a business's own company news, and does not run ads or paid subscriptions.

LongLens was built by Geoffrey Hancock, a visual effects supervisor and VES Award winner for Changeling, who runs his own newsletter on it.

## Pages

- [Home](https://getlonglens.com/): what LongLens does, the formats, who it is for, prices
- [Features](https://getlonglens.com/features/): every format, where issues go, editing on the page, changing it by reply, what LongLens does not do
- [Pricing](https://getlonglens.com/pricing/): Free week, Solo and Business, with a table of what each includes
- [How it works](https://getlonglens.com/how-it-works/): from the start form to the first issue, and how stories are picked
- [FAQ](https://getlonglens.com/faq/): answers on control, client details, formats, price and ownership
- [For accountants](https://getlonglens.com/for-accountants/): LongLens as a client newsletter for accounting firms
- [Start a free week](https://getlonglens.com/contact/): the three-field start form
